currentManifest.notes: Frozen Bash verification repository task with original checks plus the ordinary auto-background and timeout contracts. The first Luna Low pair used only the original checks; its retained post-run audit exposed an off regression. Future runs include all four checks. No required delegation or policy/concurrency overrides.

limitations: One matched pair on one production file; no autonomous delegation, isolated integration, or repair convergence measured.
Original two-check acceptance was incomplete: off passes it but fails the supplemental ordinary-command regression audit.
The supplemental audit replays recorded patches locally without model calls; it is not a hosted rerun with stronger tests.
Future packet runs use four checks. Evaluated manifests are retained in reports; their hash identifies the original two-check packet.
Reported costs are provider telemetry, not subscription quota consumption.
